# blurkit

> Universal image placeholder generation. blurkit turns an image into a BlurHash or ThumbHash placeholder `dataURL` plus the hash, encoded dimensions, and source metadata, with explicit entrypoints for Node/Bun, Deno, the browser, edge workers, Cloudflare Workers, and WASM runtimes.

- Package: blurkit (MIT), current version on npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/blurkit
- Repository: https://github.com/okazakee/blurkit
- Canonical docs: https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/
- Install: `pnpm add blurkit` (Node/Bun also need `sharp`; Deno/WASM/edge fallback need `blurkit-wasm-codecs`)

## Start here

- [Overview](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/): how `encode()` flows from input to placeholder, and what the result contains.
- [Installation](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/installation/): dependency rules and the canonical runtime compatibility matrix.
- [Quick Start](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/quick-start/): first successful encode and result fields.

## Runtime guides

- [Node Runtime](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/runtimes/node/): `blurkit/node`, sharp-backed, local paths plus URL/Blob/bytes.
- [Deno Runtime](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/runtimes/deno/): `blurkit/deno`, wasm decode, canvas or wasm render.
- [Browser Runtime](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/runtimes/browser/): `blurkit/browser`, File/Blob inputs, CORS-only remote URLs.
- [Edge Runtime](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/runtimes/edge/): `blurkit/edge`, native decode when available, wasm when not.
- [Cloudflare Runtime](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/runtimes/cloudflare/): `blurkit/cloudflare`, `cf.image` transforms, opaque `cfbh:`/`cfth:` hash.
- [WASM Runtime](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/runtimes/wasm/): `blurkit/wasm`, PNG/JPEG/WebP decode.

## API reference

- [encode()](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/api/encode/): signature, accepted inputs, errors.
- [encodeMany()](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/api/encode-many/): fail-fast and settled batch semantics.
- [Options](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/api/options/): algorithm, size, dimensions, output format, cache.
- [Result](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/api/result/): `BlurResult` fields, ThumbHash render dimensions, Cloudflare hash exception.
- [Manifest helpers](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/api/manifest/): `createManifest()` and `writeManifest()` runtime support.
- [Cache](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/api/cache/): memory, filesystem, and Cloudflare helpers; key behavior.

## CLI

- [CLI overview](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/cli/): flags, defaults, output behavior.
- [Single image](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/cli/single-image/): one `BlurResult` from a path or URL.
- [Manifest generation](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/cli/manifest-generation/): folder manifests and key mapping.

## Guides

- [Next.js](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/guides/nextjs/): `blurDataURL` in a Server Component, sharp/Turbopack caveat.
- [Build-time manifests](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/guides/build-time-manifest-generation/): precompute placeholders during builds.
- [Browser uploader flow](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/guides/browser-uploader-flow/): client-side placeholders for user uploads.
- [CMS import pipeline](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/guides/cms-import-pipeline/): encode during import jobs.

## Policy

- [Limits and caveats](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/limits/): runtime boundaries, error codes, cache ownership.
- [Roadmap](https://blurkit.okazakee.dev/docs/roadmap/): committed work, exploratory ideas, and unsupported features.
